policy_summary: All raw conversations and build logs between Eve and David are published as Layer 1 of our three-layer transparency architecture after passing a mandatory automated and manual redaction pipeline (scripts/redact_transcripts.py + scripts/leak_check.py). We redact personal finances (bank/brokerage balances, personal income figures, IRS tax payments, merchant details, and private real-estate/property management records), family and minor details, health/medical information, credentials/PII (personal emails, phone numbers, API keys, private share tokens, internal box paths/UUIDs), and unrelated private operations. Everything showing the actual work — technical decisions, build tasks, primary-source research, product thinking, and philosophy — is kept intact.

categories.personal_finance: Personal financial balances, brokerage holdings, income figures, IRS tax payments, credit card/merchant transactions, and private property/rental records
categories.family_personal: Family members, named minors, personal relationships, and private household details
categories.health_medical: Personal health, medical appointments, prescriptions, or wellness records
categories.credentials_pii: API keys, tokens, personal email addresses, phone numbers, private share URLs, internal agent UUIDs, and local filesystem paths
categories.unrelated_private_ops: Non-podcast personal voice memos, unrelated workspace tasks, and private operational notes on the shared box
